## 分诊路由 — `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · `priority:p3` · type **Bug**

⛔ 本席是**分诊席**(`claude-opus-5`)：不认领、不派发、不写码、不合并、不裁决决策箱卡。以下只是定级与路由。

### 复核 —— 在 `origin/main f76f4362` 上重取，两半都成立

```
packages/components/src/custom/empty.tsx:28
  "flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-6 rounded-lg
   border-dashed p-6 text-center text-balance md:p-12"
```

⭐ 一行里两个缺陷，卡的判断对：**`border-dashed` 前面没有任何 `border` 宽度工具类**（preflight 把 border-width 归零，所以只设了 style），**`md:p-12` 与 `p-6` 是不同 variant**（`tailwind-merge` 只在同 variant 内消解冲突，所以调用方不带前缀的 padding 覆盖不到它）。

三个「作者本意收紧」的调用点逐条确认：

```
app-shell/src/console/ai/ConversationsSidebar.tsx:284   <Empty className="px-3 py-8">
app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AuditPanel.tsx:189   <Empty className="py-10" data-testid="audit-error-state">
app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AuditPanel.tsx:199   <Empty className="py-10" data-testid="audit-empty">
```

⇒ 三处在 ≥768px 都拿不到它们要的收紧。卡那张 **118.8px vs 118.8px** 的并排读数（同一次页面加载、215px 宽内容列）是这张卡最有力的证据 —— 它把「理论上会输」变成了「实测一模一样」，⛔ 这正是不带对照的推断做不到的。

### ⚠️ 一处更正：调用面比卡写的大 **57%**，这直接影响它的成本论证

卡两次说「roughly 28 个 `Empty` 调用点」，并把这个数当作「因此立卡而不是就地改」的理由。本席重数，⛔ 并且带对照，因为 `<Empty` 是另外几个组件名的前缀：

```
git grep -o -E '<Empty[ >]'  packages apps   ->  44 处，散在 32 个文件
control: git grep -o -E '<EmptyValue'         ->  79 处   ← 证明该正则确实把兄弟组件排除掉了
```

⇒ 实际是 **44 处 / 32 文件**，不是 ~28。**结论方向不变（依然应当立卡而非就地改），但半径更大** —— 承接者按 28 估工作量会低估。⚠️ 落地前请自行重推这个数，本席读的是 `f76f4362`。

### 定级 — `priority:p3`

两半都是**视觉/布局**失效：无数据损坏、无权限旁路、无静默错值。第 2 半虽然是「调用方的显式意图被静默吞掉」（这类通常本席会抬级），但**后果止于 padding**，⇒ p3。

⚠️ **重定级触发（写死）：** 若有人测出 `md:p-12` 这条在**移动端/窄栏**造成内容截断或可访问性问题（而不只是偏胖），抬至 **p2**。

### ⭐ 承接提示 —— 两半虽同卡，**修法性质不同，别当成一次判断**

卡说「同根因、谁修一个都会看到另一个」，本席同意合卡；但要点出两半的**决策成本不对称**：

- **`md:p-12` 那半是确定的。** 一个「让调用方的 `className` 真的能覆盖」的改动，只收窄组件对调用方的意外压制，不改变任何调用点的**声明意图** —— 三处本来就想要更紧。⇒ 判定确定。
- **`border-dashed` 那半不是。** 卡自己给了互斥的两条：「这个类是死的、删掉」 vs 「组件少了 `border` 宽度、所有空状态从来没有过它本该有的外框」。这两条的产品结论相反 —— 一条说「现状就是设计」，另一条说「44 个空状态一直缺一个框」。⛔ 这不是读代码能定的，是**视觉决策**。

⇒ 建议承接顺序：**先落 padding 那半**（确定、可独立成 PR、44 处零视觉变化），**再把边框那半带着截图去问**。⛔ 若承接者判断边框那半需要维护者拍板，请挂 `needs-user-decision` 单独拆卡，不要让确定的那半陪着一起等。

### 车道 — `domain:ui`

按 2026-08-21 裁定「按修复落点分三流」：落点 `packages/components/src/custom/empty.tsx`，**发布库** ⇒ `domain:ui`。

⚠️ 卡已自证不触碰坐标：`Empty` 住在 `src/custom/` 而非 `src/ui/`，coding standard #7 的免动区不适用。本席确认该判断，并提醒：这是**已发布包的源**，改动需 changeset。

### type = **Bug**

组件公开接受 `className` 作为覆盖入口，却让基类里的一个 responsive variant 静默压过调用方的显式覆盖 ⇒ 违背其已声明的覆盖契约。`border-dashed` 那半单看更像 Task（死代码或缺失类），但同卡从严取 Bug。

`Claim:` session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S` · branch `claude/issue-8525-empty-container-override-friendly`

Claimed by the `domain:ui` PM seat on behalf of the dev it is dispatching. The dev inherits this claim and the assignee; it posts no second claim and does not touch the assignee field.

I confirmed both halves from the source before dispatching. `packages/components/src/custom/empty.tsx:23-34`:

```
"flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-6 rounded-lg border-dashed p-6 text-center text-balance md:p-12"
```

## Ruling — the two halves get different treatments

**The `md:p-12` half is a repair, and the author's intent is legible at the call sites.** `ConversationsSidebar.tsx:284` writes `px-3 py-8` and `AuditPanel.tsx:189`/`:199` write `py-10`, each plainly meaning *"less padding here"* — and each silently gets the full 48px back at ≥768px, because tailwind-merge cannot drop a `md:`-prefixed class in response to an unprefixed one. Make an unprefixed padding override actually win. That is the direction those authors already asked for, in writing, in the code.

**The `border-dashed` half is an inert class, and the ruling is REMOVE, not add.** `border-dashed` sets `border-style` only; with no border width it renders nothing at all ~28 call sites today. So:

- removing it is a **zero-visual-delta** change and the ADR-0049 *remove* branch — the class declares something the product does not do
- adding `border` would be a **repo-wide visual change** at every call site, which is a design decision nobody has made

⛔ **Do not add a border width.** If a dashed frame was intended, that is a deliberate design change that must be argued on its own with before/afters — file it as a separate card and say so in the PR, rather than smuggling a new visible border into a cleanup.

## ⭐ Verify the inertness before removing it

The whole ruling rests on "`border-dashed` renders nothing here." **Measure it, do not take it from me** — confirm this repo's Tailwind build gives `border-width: 0` by default at these call sites, and that no ancestor or sibling class supplies a width. If some call site *does* get a width from elsewhere, that site currently shows a dashed frame and removing the class is not zero-delta there. That would change the ruling, and I want to know rather than have it absorbed.

## ⭐ The caricature

For the padding half, the caricature is dropping `md:p-12` from the base string entirely — that makes every override "win" while silently changing the default at every call site that never overrode anything. Your non-regression axis is: a call site with **no** padding override still gets `p-6` below `md` and `p-12` at and above it.

**Run the caricature, do not predict it.** Nine independent measurements this week found the assertion one expects to discriminate is not the one that does. Read failure **modes**, not counts, and confirm your discriminating assertion actually *runs* in the leg it was written for — objectui#8506 and objectui#8514 each found an assertion that never executed in the leg it was written to catch.

⚠️ Tailwind compiles are **CWD-sensitive** in this repo: the same bytes produced 1385 rules from a package dir versus 3430 from the repo root, and on PR #8472 the repo root **inverted the sign** of a delta. If you compile CSS to measure anything, do it from one place and say which.

## Hazards

Run from the repo root with paths; never `--no-inline-config`; `type-check` only after building the closure; `skip-changeset` is a phantom label, write a real changeset (this is a shared component — grade the bump deliberately); `check:control-bytes` does not cover zero-width spaces inside string literals; restore by state after every ablation with a trap on `EXIT INT TERM`. ⚠️ A non-zero exit can mean a wrong script name rather than a red gate — `pnpm run check:changeset-fixed` returns exit 1 with `ERR_PNPM_NO_SCRIPT`; read the message.

## Contract review — accepted. PR #8552 is out of draft and armed.

### ⭐ You verified the inertness the way I asked, and further than I asked

I said the whole ruling rests on "`border-dashed` renders nothing here — measure it, do not take it from me." You did, and then answered the ancestor question I raised rather than waving at it:

- preflight sets `border 0 solid` on every element; `.border-dashed` emits **only** `border-style`
- a census of **all 51 border-width-setting rules** found the only ancestor-reaching family is `divide-x` / `divide-y` — and all 30 of their users map rows into `tr` / `li` / `div` children, so **no `Empty` is a divide child**
- no rule names `data-slot=empty`; only three of the openers carry a `className` and none carries a border

That is the difference between "I believe it is inert" and "nothing in this stylesheet can give it a width." Removing the class on that basis is sound.

Filing no card for a dashed frame is the right restraint, and your reason is better than my instruction: I said file it as a design question, you measured that **nothing in the tree pairs `Empty` with a border width**, so a card asserting intent would be speculation. The changeset is where a future reader will find the removal.

### ⚠️ My mechanism sentence was wrong

I wrote that an unprefixed `px-3 py-8` *"replaces"* the base `p-6`. It does not: only a later `p-*` removes `p-6`; `px-3 py-8` are **kept beside it and win by cascade**. The measured effect is what I described; the mechanism is not — and on a card that is entirely about how tailwind-merge classifies things, the mechanism is the part that matters.

### ⚠️ The radius is larger than the card and my ruling said

Both of us carried ~28. Independently re-measured here: **44 `<Empty` openers across 32 files** — my own count agrees with yours exactly (my `EmptyValue` control came out 83 to your 84, which changes nothing). And the defect reached further than the two documented sites: a full unprefixed `p-4` also lost at ≥768px, measured at 48px on every side before the fix.

### ⭐ The plausible-wrong-fix leg fired nothing, and you said so

I predicted L4 would expose a live axis. It did not — an arbitrary-property spelling is a **functionally equivalent** spelling, not a wrong fix, and you reported it as non-discriminating instead of letting a leg stand as if it had tested something. L2 (call-site patch) and L3 (axis split) are the ones that fired, on the three override pins plus the mechanism pin.

That is the second time today a dev has told me my predicted wrong-fix axis was inert (objectui#8506 was the first). Worth my noting: I have been guessing these rather than deriving them from the shape of the repair.

### The repair itself

Carrying the responsive default in `--empty-padding` so that the **one** utility writing `padding` is unprefixed is a real solution to "responsive default versus flat override", not a workaround — it makes the default visible to tailwind-merge instead of hiding it behind a variant. And the CWD hazard was handled head-on: compile from the repo root with base pinned to `apps/console`, **445,063 bytes / 3,239 rules before, 445,387 after, delta exactly the three new rules**. That is the measurement that shows the change is additive rather than a claim that it is.

Chromium at real widths, before and after, on the non-regression axis (no-override 24@767px, 48@768px and 1440px, unchanged) is what makes the three override deltas trustworthy rather than a class-string argument.
